series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

derived.$note: Trend: least-squares slope over 35 observed years (1990-2024) from DS-35, compared against the DS-06-NDC-LATEST target of 0.272 MtCO₂e by 2035. DS-05's rows are non-CO₂ gases only and are not comparable with the others; that is also why DS-05 is absent from series.observed, where a shorter curve would read as a disagreement rather than a difference of scope. by_source carries each source whole.

verdict.text: Andorra pledges a 63% reduction by 2035 against 2005 baseline (condition not read). The registry's current submission for this Party is Third NDC, filed 2025-02-05. 46 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-35 0.5 MtCO₂e, DS-02 0.3 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. The target is not reached on the observed trend: it would need cuts 11.215× faster. Both figures are on DS-35's inventory: the document's percentage applied to DS-35's 2005 level, not the document's own. It submitted BTR1. 2 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 63.0 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 37% (193.73 Gg CO2eq) reduction in 2030 compared to the BAU scenario It was classed unconditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.42°C under SSP1-2.6 to +4.87°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
